23/// Single-threaded implementation of the rendering dispatcher.
24///
25/// This dispatcher handles the entire rendering pipeline on a single thread,
26/// including path rasterization, layer composition, and filter effects.
27/// It maintains the coarse tile grid (`Wide`), strip generation for paths,
28/// and the render graph for managing layer dependencies and filter effects.
29#[derive(Debug)]
30pub(crate) struct SingleThreadedDispatcher {
31    /// Coarse tile grid containing rendering commands for each wide tile.
32    wide: Wide,
33    /// Clip context for managing non-isolated clipping.
34    clip_context: ClipContext,
35    /// Generator for converting paths into coverage strips.
36    strip_generator: StripGenerator,
37    /// Storage for alpha coverage data from strip generation.
38    strip_storage: StripStorage,
39    /// SIMD level for fearless SIMD dispatch.
40    level: Level,
41    /// Counter for generating unique layer IDs.
42    layer_id_next: u32,
43    /// Dependency graph tracking layer relationships and filter effects.
44    render_graph: RenderGraph,
45    /// PdfCraft patch (1): a path was left out because the scene's coverage was full.
46    coverage_full: bool,
47    /// PdfCraft patch (1): the most coverage values the scene keeps
48    /// ([`Dispatcher::set_max_coverage`]).
49    max_coverage: usize,
50}
51
52impl SingleThreadedDispatcher {
53    /// Creates a new single-threaded dispatcher for the given dimensions.
54    ///
55    /// # Arguments
56    /// * `width` - Width of the rendering surface in pixels.
57    /// * `height` - Height of the rendering surface in pixels.
58    /// * `level` - SIMD level to use for rasterization.
59    ///
60    /// # Notes
61    /// The root layer (`layer_id` 0) is created immediately and must be node 0
62    /// in the render graph for proper rendering order.
63    pub(crate) fn new(width: u16, height: u16, level: Level) -> Self {
64        let wide = Wide::<MODE_CPU>::new(width, height);
65        let strip_generator = StripGenerator::new(width, height, level);
66        let clip_context = ClipContext::new();
67        let strip_storage = StripStorage::default();
68        let mut render_graph = RenderGraph::new();
69
70        // Create root node (layer_id 0) as the first node (will be node 0).
71        // This ensures the root layer is always rendered last in the execution order.
72        let wtile_bbox = WideTilesBbox::new(0, 0, wide.width_tiles(), wide.height_tiles());
73        let root_node = render_graph.add_node(RenderNodeKind::RootLayer { layer_id: 0, wtile_bbox });
74        assert_eq!(root_node, 0, "Root node must be node 0");
75
76        Self {
77            wide,
78            clip_context,
79            strip_generator,
80            strip_storage,
81            level,
82            layer_id_next: 0,
83            render_graph,
84            coverage_full: false,
85            max_coverage: usize::MAX,
86        }
87    }
88
89    /// PdfCraft patch (1): whether the scene has room for the coverage of one more path
90    /// ([`StripStorage::room_for_path`]). Once it hasn't, the path and every later one are left
91    /// out, and [`Dispatcher::coverage_full`] says so.
92    fn room_for_path(&mut self) -> bool {
93        let (width, height) = (self.strip_generator.width(), self.strip_generator.height());
94        let room = self.strip_storage.room_for_path_within(width, height, self.max_coverage);
95        if !room {
96            self.coverage_full = true;
97        }
98        room
99    }
100
101    /// Rasterizes the scene using f32 precision (high quality).
102    ///
103    /// This dispatches to the appropriate SIMD implementation based on the
104    /// configured level, using f32 for intermediate calculations.
105    #[cfg(any())]
106    fn rasterize_f32(&self, buffer: &mut [u8], width: u16, height: u16, encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint], image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver) {
107        use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::dispatch;
108        use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::F32Kernel;
109        dispatch!(self.level, simd => self.rasterize_with::<_, F32Kernel>(simd, buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver));
110    }
111
112    /// Rasterizes the scene using u8 precision (fast).
113    ///
114    /// This dispatches to the appropriate SIMD implementation based on the
115    /// configured level, using u8 for intermediate calculations to maximize speed.
116    fn rasterize_u8(&self, buffer: &mut [u8], width: u16, height: u16, encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint], image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver) {
117        use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::dispatch;
118        use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::U8Kernel;
119        dispatch!(self.level, simd => self.rasterize_with::<_, U8Kernel>(simd, buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver));
120    }
121
122    /// Core rasterization dispatcher that chooses between simple and filter-aware paths.
123    ///
124    /// # Type Parameters
125    /// * `S` - SIMD implementation to use.
126    /// * `F` - Fine rasterization kernel (determines precision).
127    ///
128    /// If the scene contains filter effects, uses the filter-aware path which maintains
129    /// intermediate layer buffers. Otherwise, uses the simpler direct rasterization path.
130    fn rasterize_with<S: Simd, F: FineKernel<S>>(
131        &self,
132        simd: S,
133        buffer: &mut [u8],
134        width: u16,
135        height: u16,
136        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
137        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
138    ) {
139        let mut layer_manager = LayerManager::new();
140
141        if self.has_filters() {
142            // Use filter-aware path that maintains layer buffers for filter effects.
143            self.rasterize_with_filters::<S, F>(simd, buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver, &mut layer_manager);
144        } else {
145            // Use simple direct rasterization for scenes without filters.
146            self.rasterize_simple::<S, F>(simd, buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
147        }
148    }
149
150    /// Rasterizes a scene with filter effects using dependency-ordered execution.
151    ///
152    /// This processes the render graph in topological order, ensuring that filtered
153    /// layers are rendered into intermediate buffers before being composed. Each
154    /// filter layer is rendered to its own pixmap, the filter is applied, and then
155    /// the result is stored in the layer manager for use by dependent layers.
156    ///
157    /// # Render Graph Execution
158    /// - `FilterLayer` nodes: Render to intermediate buffer, apply filter, store result.
159    /// - `RootLayer` node: Final composition to output buffer.
160    fn rasterize_with_filters<S: Simd, F: FineKernel<S>>(
161        &self,
162        simd: S,
163        buffer: &mut [u8],
164        width: u16,
165        height: u16,
166        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
167        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
168        layer_manager: &mut LayerManager,
169    ) {
170        let mut fine = Fine::<S, F>::new(simd);
171
172        // Process nodes in dependency order (filtered layers before their consumers).
173        for node_id in self.render_graph.execution_order() {
174            let node = &self.render_graph.nodes[node_id];
175
176            match &node.kind {
177                RenderNodeKind::FilterLayer { layer_id, filter, wtile_bbox, transform } => {
178                    // Allocate intermediate buffer for this filtered layer.
179                    let bbox_width = wtile_bbox.width_px();
180                    let bbox_height = wtile_bbox.height_px();
181                    let mut pixmap = Pixmap::new(bbox_width, bbox_height);
182                    // TODO: Re-use this allocation by adding a .configure() or similar method
183                    // to avoid allocating the internal Vec<Region> on every filtered layer.
184                    let mut regions = Regions::new(bbox_width, bbox_height, pixmap.data_as_u8_slice_mut());
185
186                    // Render each tile in the layer's bounding box.
187                    regions.update_regions(|region| {
188                        // Convert region-local coords to global wtile coords.
189                        let x = wtile_bbox.x0() + region.x;
190                        let y = wtile_bbox.y0() + region.y;
191
192                        self.process_layer_tile(
193                            &mut fine,
194                            x,
195                            y,
196                            *layer_id,
197                            PremulColor::from_alpha_color(TRANSPARENT),
198                            layer_manager,
199                            encoded_paints,
200                            image_resolver,
201                        );
202
203                        debug_assert_eq!(fine.blend_buf.len(), 1, "blend buffer should contain exactly one layer after tile processing");
204
205                        fine.pack(region);
206                    });
207
208                    // Apply the filter effect to the completed layer.
209                    fine.filter_layer(&mut pixmap, filter, layer_manager, *transform);
210
211                    // Save the filtered pixmap to disk for debugging.
212                    // #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
213                    // save_filtered_layer_debug(&pixmap, *layer_id);
214
215                    // Store the filtered result for use by dependent layers.
216                    layer_manager.register_layer(*layer_id, *wtile_bbox, pixmap);
217                }
218                RenderNodeKind::RootLayer { layer_id, wtile_bbox: _ } => {
219                    // Final composition directly to output buffer.
220                    let mut regions = Regions::new(width, height, buffer);
221                    regions.update_regions(|region| {
222                        // Use the background color from the wide tile.
223                        let bg = self.wide.get(region.x, region.y).bg;
224                        self.process_layer_tile(&mut fine, region.x, region.y, *layer_id, bg, layer_manager, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
225
226                        debug_assert_eq!(fine.blend_buf.len(), 1, "blend buffer should contain exactly one layer after tile processing");
227
228                        fine.pack(region);
229                    });
230                }
231            }
232        }
233    }
234
235    /// Processes all rendering commands for a single layer within a specific tile.
236    ///
237    /// This handles the complex logic of composing filtered layers by:
238    /// 1. Running normal rendering commands in sequence.
239    /// 2. When encountering a filtered layer reference, compositing its pre-rendered
240    ///    content from the layer manager.
241    /// 3. Skipping the filtered layer's internal commands (already rendered separately).
242    ///
243    /// # Arguments
244    /// * `fine` - The fine rasterizer instance.
245    /// * `x`, `y` - Wide tile coordinates.
246    /// * `layer_id` - The layer being processed.
247    /// * `clear_color` - Initial color for the tile.
248    /// * `layer_manager` - Storage for filtered layer buffers.
249    /// * `encoded_paints` - Paint definitions for the scene.
250    /// * `image_resolver` - Resolver for looking up opaque image IDs.
251    fn process_layer_tile<S: Simd, F: FineKernel<S>>(
252        &self,
253        fine: &mut Fine<S, F>,
254        x: u16,
255        y: u16,
256        layer_id: u32,
257        clear_color: PremulColor,
258        layer_manager: &mut LayerManager,
259        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
260        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
261    ) {
262        let wtile = &self.wide.get(x, y);
263        fine.set_coords(x, y);
264        fine.clear(clear_color);
265
266        // Process all commands in this layer's render range.
267        // It can happen that the layer has no associated ranges in this wide tile in
268        // case they have been cleared by setting a new wide tile background, for example
269        // when filling a full-tile opaque solid color.
270        let Some(ranges) = wtile.layer_cmd_ranges.get(&layer_id) else {
271            return;
272        };
273
274        let mut cmd_idx = ranges.render_range.start;
275        while cmd_idx < ranges.render_range.end {
276            let cmd: &Cmd = &wtile.cmds[cmd_idx];
277
278            fine.run_cmd(cmd, &self.strip_storage.alphas, encoded_paints, image_resolver, &self.wide.attrs);
279
280            // Special handling for filtered layer composition.
281            // Filtered layers have already been rendered and stored in layer_manager.
282            // Here we composite them into the current buffer, with special handling for clipping.
283            if let Cmd::PushBuf(LayerKind::Filtered(child_layer_id), _) = cmd {
284                // Unlike above, the unwrap is safe here because as long as the filtered layer
285                // is referenced in the wide tile, it must have associated layer ranges.
286                let filtered_ranges = wtile.layer_cmd_ranges.get(child_layer_id).unwrap();
287
288                // Check what comes after the filtered layer push to determine clipping state
289                match wtile.cmds.get(cmd_idx + 1) {
290                    // Zero-clip region: tile is completely outside the clip path.
291                    // The layer was already rendered for filtering, but we skip compositing
292                    // since this tile is entirely clipped out.
293                    // (PushZeroClip only appears for clipped filter layers)
294                    // See https://github.com/linebender/vello/pull/1541/ for why we
295                    // add the ID check.
296                    Some(Cmd::PushZeroClip(id)) if *id == *child_layer_id => {
297                        // If we have a zero-clip, it means that the whole layer should not be drawn.
298                        // Therefore, we want to skip to the very end so that only `PopBuf` will
299                        // be run. Therefore, we jump to `filtered_ranges.full_range.end - 1`.
300                        cmd_idx = filtered_ranges.full_range.end - 1;
301                        continue;
302                    }
303
304                    // Partial clip: push the clip buffer, then composite the filtered layer
305                    Some(Cmd::PushBuf(LayerKind::Clip(id), _)) if *id == *child_layer_id => {
306                        fine.run_cmd(&wtile.cmds[cmd_idx + 1], &self.strip_storage.alphas, encoded_paints, image_resolver, &self.wide.attrs);
307                        cmd_idx += 1;
308
309                        if let Some(mut region) = layer_manager.layer_tile_region_mut(*child_layer_id, x, y) {
310                            fine.unpack(&mut region);
311                        }
312                    }
313
314                    // No clip or fully inside clip: composite the filtered layer directly
315                    _ => {
316                        if let Some(mut region) = layer_manager.layer_tile_region_mut(*child_layer_id, x, y) {
317                            fine.unpack(&mut region);
318                        }
319                    }
320                }
321
322                // Skip past the filtered layer's internal commands, as they were already
323                // rendered when the FilterLayer node was processed earlier.
324                cmd_idx = filtered_ranges.render_range.end.max(cmd_idx + 1);
325            } else {
326                cmd_idx += 1;
327            }
328        }
329    }

331    /// Simple rasterization path for scenes without filter effects.
332    ///
333    /// This directly processes each tile's commands without maintaining intermediate
334    /// layer buffers. All rendering happens in a single pass directly to the output buffer.
335    /// This is more efficient than the filter-aware path when no filters are present.
336    fn rasterize_simple<S: Simd, F: FineKernel<S>>(
337        &self,
338        simd: S,
339        buffer: &mut [u8],
340        width: u16,
341        height: u16,
342        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
343        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
344    ) {
345        let mut regions = Regions::new(width, height, buffer);
346        let mut fine = Fine::<S, F>::new(simd);
347
348        regions.update_regions(|region| {
349            let x = region.x;
350            let y = region.y;
351
352            let wtile = self.wide.get(x, y);
353            fine.set_coords(x, y);
354
355            // Clear to background and process all commands in order.
356            fine.clear(wtile.bg);
357            for cmd in &wtile.cmds {
358                fine.run_cmd(cmd, &self.strip_storage.alphas, encoded_paints, image_resolver, &self.wide.attrs);
359            }
360
361            fine.pack(region);
362        });
363    }

365    /// Returns true if the scene contains any filter effects.

367        self.render_graph.has_filters()
368    }

391    /// Composites at an offset using u8 precision (fast).
392    fn composite_at_offset_u8(
393        &self,
394        buffer: &mut [u8],
395        width: u16,
396        height: u16,
397        dst_x: u16,

411    /// Core implementation for compositing at an offset.
412    ///
413    /// Composites tiles sequentially, writing directly to the destination buffer
414    /// at the specified offset.
415    fn composite_at_offset_with<S: Simd, F: FineKernel<S>>(
416        &self,
417        simd: S,
418        buffer: &mut [u8],
419        width: u16,
420        height: u16,
421        dst_x: u16,
422        dst_y: u16,
423        dst_buffer_width: u16,
424        dst_buffer_height: u16,
425        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
426        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
427    ) {
428        let mut regions = Regions::new_at_offset(width, height, dst_x, dst_y, dst_buffer_width, dst_buffer_height, buffer);
429        let mut fine = Fine::<S, F>::new(simd);
430
431        regions.update_regions(|region| {
432            let x = region.x;
433            let y = region.y;
434
435            let wtile = self.wide.get(x, y);
436            fine.set_coords(x, y);
437
438            // Unpack existing pixel data from the region instead of clearing,
439            // so that rendering composites onto the existing pixmap contents.
440            fine.unpack(region);
441            for cmd in &wtile.cmds {
442                fine.run_cmd(cmd, &self.strip_storage.alphas, encoded_paints, image_resolver, &self.wide.attrs);
443            }
444            fine.pack(region);
445        });
446    }
447}
448
449impl Dispatcher for SingleThreadedDispatcher {
450    fn wide(&self) -> &Wide {
451        &self.wide
452    }
453
454    fn fill_path(
455        &mut self,
456        path: &BezPath,
457        fill_rule: Fill,
458        transform: Affine,
459        paint: Paint,
460        blend_mode: BlendMode,
461        aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>,
462        mask: Option<Mask>,
463        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
464    ) {
465        if !self.room_for_path() {
466            return;
467        }
468        let wide = &mut self.wide;
469
470        // Convert path to coverage strips.
471        self.strip_generator.generate_filled_path(path, fill_rule, transform, aliasing_threshold, &mut self.strip_storage, self.clip_context.get());
472
473        // Generate coarse-level commands from strips (thread_idx 0 for single-threaded).
474        wide.generate(&self.strip_storage.strips, paint, blend_mode, 0, mask, encoded_paints);
475    }
476
477    fn stroke_path(
478        &mut self,
479        path: &BezPath,
480        stroke: &Stroke,
481        transform: Affine,
482        paint: Paint,
483        blend_mode: BlendMode,
484        aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>,
485        mask: Option<Mask>,
486        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
487    ) {
488        if !self.room_for_path() {
489            return;
490        }
491        let wide = &mut self.wide;
492
493        // Convert stroked path to coverage strips.
494        self.strip_generator.generate_stroked_path(path, stroke, transform, aliasing_threshold, &mut self.strip_storage, self.clip_context.get());
495
496        // Generate coarse-level commands from strips (thread_idx 0 for single-threaded).
497        wide.generate(&self.strip_storage.strips, paint, blend_mode, 0, mask, encoded_paints);
498    }
499
500    fn fill_rect_fast(&mut self, rect: &Rect, paint: Paint, blend_mode: BlendMode, mask: Option<Mask>, encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint]) {
501        if !self.room_for_path() {
502            return;
503        }
504        let wide = &mut self.wide;
505
506        // Generate strips directly for the rectangle (bypasses path processing).
507        self.strip_generator.generate_filled_rect_fast(rect, &mut self.strip_storage, self.clip_context.get());
508
509        // Generate coarse-level commands from strips (thread_idx 0 for single-threaded).
510        wide.generate(&self.strip_storage.strips, paint, blend_mode, 0, mask, encoded_paints);
511    }
512
513    fn push_layer(
514        &mut self,
515        clip_path: Option<&BezPath>,
516        fill_rule: Fill,
517        transform: Affine,
518        blend_mode: BlendMode,
519        opacity: f32,
520        aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>,
521        mask: Option<Mask>,
522        filter: Option<Filter>,
523    ) {
524        // Allocate a new unique layer ID.
525        self.layer_id_next += 1;
526
527        // Generate clip coverage if a clip path is provided. PdfCraft patch (1): without room for
528        // it the layer goes unclipped, as nothing can be drawn into it any more either.
529        let clip = if let Some(c) = clip_path.filter(|_| self.room_for_path()) {
530            self.strip_generator.generate_filled_path(c, fill_rule, transform, aliasing_threshold, &mut self.strip_storage, self.clip_context.get());
531
532            Some(self.strip_storage.strips.as_slice())
533        } else {
534            None
535        };
536
537        // Push the layer onto the coarse tile stack and update render graph.
538        self.wide.push_layer(self.layer_id_next, clip, blend_mode, mask, opacity, filter, transform, &mut self.render_graph, 0);
539    }
540
541    fn pop_layer(&mut self) {
542        // Pop the current layer and update render graph.
543        self.wide.pop_layer(&mut self.render_graph);
544    }
545
546    fn reset(&mut self) {
547        // Clear all rendering state to prepare for a new scene.
548        self.wide.reset();
549        self.clip_context.reset();
550        self.strip_generator.reset();
551        self.strip_storage.clear();
552        self.render_graph.clear();
553        self.layer_id_next = 0;
554        self.coverage_full = false;
555
556        // Recreate root node as node 0 (required for proper execution order).
557        let root_node = self.render_graph.add_node(RenderNodeKind::RootLayer {
558            layer_id: 0,
559            wtile_bbox: WideTilesBbox::new(0, 0, self.wide.width_tiles(), self.wide.height_tiles()),
560        });
561        debug_assert_eq!(root_node, 0, "Root node must be node 0");
562
563        // Reset layer ID counter.
564        self.layer_id_next = 0;
565    }
566
567    fn flush(&mut self, _encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint]) {
568        // No-op for single-threaded dispatcher (no work queue to flush).
569    }
570
571    fn coverage_full(&self) -> bool {
572        self.coverage_full
573    }
574
575    fn set_max_coverage(&mut self, max: usize) {
576        self.max_coverage = max;
577    }
578
579    fn rasterize(
580        &self,
581        buffer: &mut [u8],
582        render_mode: RenderMode,
583        width: u16,
584        height: u16,
585        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
586        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
587    ) {
588        // If only the u8 pipeline is enabled, then use it
589        {
590            let _ = render_mode;
591            self.rasterize_u8(buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
592        }
593
594        // If only the f32 pipeline is enabled, then use it
595        #[cfg(any())]
596        {
597            let _ = render_mode;
598            self.rasterize_f32(buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
599        }
600
601        // If both pipelines are enabled, select precision based on render mode parameter.
602        #[cfg(any())]
603        match render_mode {
604            RenderMode::OptimizeSpeed => {
605                // Use u8 precision for faster rendering.
606                self.rasterize_u8(buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
607            }
608            RenderMode::OptimizeQuality => {
609                // Use f32 precision for higher quality.
610                self.rasterize_f32(buffer, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
611            }
612        }
613
614        #[cfg(any())]
615        {
616            // This case never gets hit because there is a compile_error in the root.
617            // But have this code disables some warnings and makes the compile error easier to read
618            let _ = (buffer, render_mode, width, height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
619        }
620    }
621
622    fn composite_at_offset(
623        &self,
624        buffer: &mut [u8],
625        width: u16,
626        height: u16,
627        dst_x: u16,
628        dst_y: u16,
629        dst_buffer_width: u16,
630        dst_buffer_height: u16,
631        render_mode: RenderMode,
632        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
633        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
634    ) {
635        {
636            let _ = render_mode;
637            self.composite_at_offset_u8(buffer, width, height, dst_x, dst_y, dst_buffer_width, dst_buffer_height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
638        }
639
640        #[cfg(any())]
641        {
642            let _ = render_mode;
643            self.composite_at_offset_f32(buffer, width, height, dst_x, dst_y, dst_buffer_width, dst_buffer_height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
644        }
645
646        #[cfg(any())]
647        match render_mode {
648            RenderMode::OptimizeSpeed => {
649                self.composite_at_offset_u8(buffer, width, height, dst_x, dst_y, dst_buffer_width, dst_buffer_height, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
650            }
651            RenderMode::OptimizeQuality => {
652                self.composite_at_offset_f32(
653                    buffer,
654                    width,
655                    height,
656                    dst_x,
657                    dst_y,
658                    dst_buffer_width,
659                    dst_buffer_height,
660                    encoded_paints,
661                    image_resolver,
662                );
663            }
664        }
665
666        #[cfg(any())]
667        {
668            let _ = (buffer, width, height, dst_x, dst_y, dst_buffer_width, dst_buffer_height, render_mode, encoded_paints, image_resolver);
669        }
670    }
671
672    fn push_clip_path(&mut self, path: &BezPath, fill_rule: Fill, transform: Affine, aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>) {
673        self.clip_context.push_clip(path, &mut self.strip_generator, fill_rule, transform, aliasing_threshold);
674    }
675
676    fn pop_clip_path(&mut self) {
677        self.clip_context.pop_clip();
678    }
679}

681/// Saves a filtered pixmap to disk for debugging purposes.
682/// Only available in debug builds with `std` and `png` features enabled.
683#[allow(dead_code, reason = "useful debug utility, can be enabled by uncommenting the call site")]
684#[cfg(debug_assertions)]
685fn save_filtered_layer_debug(pixmap: &Pixmap, layer_id: u32) {
686    use std::path::PathBuf;
687
688    let diffs_path = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../vello_sparse_tests/diffs");
689    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&diffs_path);
690    let filename = diffs_path.join(alloc::format!("filtered_layer_{}.png", layer_id));
691
692    if let Ok(png_data) = pixmap.clone().into_png() {
693        let _ = std::fs::write(&filename, &png_data);
694    }
695}

697#[cfg(any())]
698mod tests {
699    use super::*;
700    use crate::third_party::vello_common::color::palette::css::BLUE;
701    use crate::third_party::vello_common::kurbo::Shape;
702    use crate::third_party::vello_common::paint::PremulColor;
703    use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::kurbo::Rect;
704
705    /// Verifies that `reset()` properly clears all internal buffers and state.
706    ///
707    /// This is important to ensure that a dispatcher can be reused for multiple
708    /// rendering passes without accumulating stale data from previous frames.
709    #[cfg(any())]
710    fn buffers_cleared_on_reset() {
711        let mut dispatcher = SingleThreadedDispatcher::new(100, 100, Level::new());
712
713        // Render a simple shape to populate internal buffers.
714        dispatcher.fill_path(
715            &Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, 50.0, 50.0).to_path(0.1),
716            Fill::NonZero,
717            Affine::IDENTITY,
718            Paint::Solid(PremulColor::from_alpha_color(BLUE)),
719            BlendMode::default(),
720            None,
721            None,
722            &[],
723        );
724
725        // Ensure there is data to clear.
726        assert!(!dispatcher.strip_storage.alphas.is_empty());
727        assert!(!dispatcher.wide.get(0, 0).cmds.is_empty());
728
729        dispatcher.reset();
730
731        // Verify all buffers are cleared.
732        assert!(dispatcher.strip_storage.alphas.is_empty());
733        assert!(dispatcher.wide.get(0, 0).cmds.is_empty());
734        assert_eq!(dispatcher.layer_id_next, 0);
735    }
736}
